Game credits

2048

Created by Gabriele Cirulli. The game and original icon come from the creator’s MIT-licensed repository.

MIT license · Bijan’s Lair changes · Upstream source

Hextris

Created by Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane, Noah Moroze, and Michael Yang. Bijan’s Lair hosts a modified version under GPL version 3 or later with the original icon.

GPL license · Bijan’s Lair changes · Download playable source · Upstream source

Chrome Dinosaur Game

The Chromium Authors. Original runner code, sprite sheets, and sounds from Chromium 74. Bijan’s Lair supplies a web page to launch the game.

BSD license · Bijan’s Lair changes · Upstream source

A Dark Room

Created by Michael Townsend and contributors at Doublespeak Games. The original web game and cover art come from the creator’s repository.

MPL 2.0 license · Bijan’s Lair changes · Download playable source · Upstream source

Retro Bowl

Created by New Star Games. The game code and icon came from the ZIP supplied for Bijan’s Lair. Missing runtime assets came from a matching third-party backup. The archive includes an MIT notice credited to Echo.

Notice included in the archive

Escape Road

The supplied launcher identifies this build as Escape Road 2.0 by 1Games.io. Bijan’s Lair serves the Unity files and loading artwork referenced by the launcher, with a local launcher and compatibility changes for unavailable ad and analytics services.

Snow Rider 3D

The game card uses artwork from the supplied ZIP. The ZIP linked to a game host that no longer resolves, so Bijan’s Lair serves a standalone Unity build with a local launcher.

Unity build files

Slope

The supplied archive credits Y8 Games. Bijan’s Lair hosts the WebAssembly build from the ZIP with a local launcher and custom card art.

Basketball Stars

The ZIP supplied audio and a separate landing page. Bijan’s Lair uses a complete browser build.

Build source

Tiny Fishing

The ZIP linked to a play page. Bijan’s Lair hosts a standalone build.

Build source

OvO

Bijan’s Lair hosts the OvO 1.4.4 browser build. The supplied ZIP contained research examples.

Build source

Monkey Mart

Bijan’s Lair hosts TinyDobbins’ Monkey Mart. The supplied ZIP contained a financial simulation.

Build source

Stickman Hook

Created by Madbox. Bijan’s Lair hosts the build and artwork referenced by the supplied launch page, with a local replacement for platform services.

Build source

OvO 2

Bijan’s Lair hosts the Construct build and artwork referenced by the supplied launch page, with its worker served locally.

Build source

Planet Clicker

Created by Coltroc in Scratch and packaged with TurboWarp. Bijan’s Lair serves the supplied build and its thumbnail sprite, with network access limited to local assets.

Original project · CC BY-SA 2.0

Games Hub

These games come from Saurabh Singh’s Games Hub collection supplied for Bijan’s Lair. The imports use local copies of the required Phaser runtimes and Bijan’s Lair card artwork.
